utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can bring my tools by later today. Just let me know what time works for you.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. Later this afternoon would be best for me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll swing by later this afternoon. Just text me the exact time when you know it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’m a little worried about the logistics — do we know where people should drop things off and who’s coordinating it?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not sure yet—can you confirm who’s in charge and where the drop-off spot will be?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can ask around and see who’s coordinating, but I still need a clear drop-off spot before we can really plan it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I might’ve missed the latest update—what’s the plan?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the repair drive—I'm a bit fuzzy, but I think we're gathering tools and volunteers first. I should check the notice again and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it—I'll keep an eye out for the notice too. Just let me know when you find the details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m going to mention the repair drive to a few neighbors and see who can help out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s a good idea — I can ask around when I’m out running errands too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I’ll keep spreading the word and let you know who’s interested.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late — what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries — we still need a few tools, mostly a drill, some screwdrivers, and a hammer. I can lend what I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Gus — I can grab the drill and screwdrivers. If you’ve got a hammer, that should cover us.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Quinn — let’s keep it simple and clear. Tell me what needs fixing first, and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Let’s start with the leaky faucet by the side sink, then the loose porch step—I'll round up a few neighbors and keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me, Quinn — faucet first, then the porch step. Keep me posted on the time, and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going, Sam?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s going pretty well—folks have been generous, and we’re still collecting a few more items today.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—what do you still need most?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad the repair drive is coming together—happy to help connect folks if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — that would be really helpful. I’m keeping a list of who’s reached out and where they’re coming from, so any connections you make will make things a lot smoother.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course — I’ll reach out to a few people I know and pass along your list so we can keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks for organizing the repair drive, Rosa — I’m happy to help out. Just let me know what you need me to bring or fix.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Mara — that’s so kind. Could you bring your toolbox and help with the shelf and loose fence board?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll bring my toolbox and help with the shelf and the loose fence board.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a quick tally of what we still need for the repair drive — I can check the supplies if you want.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, please check the supplies and give me the short version. I’m trying to keep this moving.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still short on tape, screws, and a couple extension cords. I’ll keep checking and flag anything else if I spot it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely — folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all afternoon. If you’re heading over, I’d go early before the good stuff runs out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good to hear. I’ll stop by early, then.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Smart move — I’d hate for you to miss the best picks. Let me know what you find over there!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what’s already been confirmed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We’ve confirmed the repair drive is on, and I’m coordinating around the school schedule so we don’t clash with pickup times. I can check what else is locked in and send you a quick update.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. Please send me the confirmed details when you can, especially the timing and any items still needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—I’m in, just keep me posted on the details.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely—I’ll swing back once I’ve got the time and place nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks—I’ll watch for your update.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that would be a huge help. I’ll keep you in the loop if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll let folks know and keep them updated if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive—I'm sorry, I missed the details. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. If you could spare a bit of time or a tool kit, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I can probably swing by with my tool kit later today. Just tell me where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive—what still needs to be fixed?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: A few porch steps, a leaky faucet, and one stubborn bike chain still need work—if you’ve got time, I can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be helpful, thanks. I can start with the porch steps if you show me where.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Opal — I’m keeping the repair drive list tidy and I’ll share the next steps as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye on the list and note any location changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — that helps a lot. I’ll post any updates right away if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need the timing and drop-off details first so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — the repair drive runs Saturday from 10 to 2, and you can drop things off at my garage on Maple. I’ll send you the full details now!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — that works for me, and I’ll wait for the full details before I plan anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we definitely still on for the repair drive, Hana?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, we’re still on—but I want to double-check the time and what we’re bringing before I say it’s fully set.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great—can you confirm the time and list what we’re bringing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help, Dane—just tell me the plan for the repair drive and I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Eli — I’ll join a bit late, but I can help where needed. Just send me the plan and I’ll follow along.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Dane — I’ll send a simple plan before we go, and you can jump in whenever you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard a little about the repair drive, but I’m still catching up—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still gathering donated tools and spare parts, and I’m keeping a running list of what we still need. If you’ve got anything handy, I can add it right in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps—I’ll check what I’ve got at home and let you know. If I hear any updates from around the block, I’ll pass them along too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I meant to bring the boxes over, but I’m a bit scattered today; I can still help if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, Oren — I’d really appreciate the help. If you can bring the boxes over, we’ll sort them together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I’ll grab the boxes and head over now. If I forget anything, just give me a quick nudge.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off times so we can plan the repair drive without any conflicts.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, that’d help a lot. I’ll send you the repair times so we can avoid pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — send them over when you can, and I’ll work around the school schedule.
